Improvements

Improvements to the base engine can be applied at three points in the assembly flow at Acme Rocket Supply.

Injector

Injector upgrades swap the stock nozzle plate for a machined manifold. The machined manifold atomizes fuel into a finer spray, which burns more evenly across the chamber and lifts thrust by a measurable margin on the Acme Rocket Supply test stand.

Turbopump

Turbopump balancing removes vibration at high spool speeds. Technicians spin each rotor on the balancing rig, add trim weights, and log the result before the pump returns to the Acme Rocket Supply assembly line.
